A El Silbón nada lo mata. Si te pierde d: Nothing kills El Silbón. If it loses sight of you it searches a while and leaves: slip into a nook (the chalk hand) or lead it to the abyss, it never looks where it steps.
Agarrar o abrir; mantén para girar: Grab or open; hold to turn
Agarrar, abrir; mantén para girar ruedas: Grab, open; hold to turn wheels, pick up panas or catch what's thrown at you
At the end of each floor the way down opens. Leave with what you have, or go one floor deeper?
Al subir de rango se abren pactos, en Má: Ranking up opens pacts, under More settings in the room: harder rules that raise the Heat. Each point of Heat gives 10% more bolívares and XP.
Algo corre por el techo…: Something is scurrying across the ceiling…
Someone grabbed the {item}. Something woke up.
Alguien pasa las páginas en la oscuridad: Someone is turning pages in the dark…
Apunta adentro del carrito. Una carga mo: Aim inside the cart. A heaped load falls off if you stop, turn or crash hard.
Apunta con el punto del centro a lo que: Aim the centre dot at what you want to use: levers, the cart, treasures, the shop. Each hand carries a treasure, a tool or a handful of four pieces.
Aquí se amarra un puente con una cuerda: A rope can string a bridge here
Bajar y subir por la cuerda es más rápid: Climbing a rope is faster when a pana holds it at either end.
Bajen en el montacargas, llenen el carri: Ride the lift down, fill the cart with what the shift asks for and send it up. What you bring becomes mangos for the camp shop, and the next shift goes deeper. Every treasure wakes the ruin's greed.
Cada jornada pide una cuota: llenen el c: Each shift asks for a quota: fill the cart, push it onto the cargo platform and press the yellow button. Once the load sent up meets the quota, the lift takes you up and the shift ends.
Cada jornada trae un encargo aparte: mír: Each shift brings a side job: check it on the map. Finishing it pays mangos.
Cada mano lleva un tesoro, una herramien: Each hand holds a treasure, a tool or a handful of four pieces: drop them in the cart (E) or throw them in (G).
Cada tesoro que levantan sube la codicia: Every treasure you lift raises the greed: more traps, angrier mummies, collapsing tunnels and a black jaguar hunting you.
Cambió el anfitrión. La expedición conti: The host changed. The expedition goes on.
Cayeron todos. Del camión solo se salvó: Everyone fell. Only {share}% of the truck was saved. {why}
El anfitrión prepara la salida: The host is getting the expedition ready
The lantern lights an empty corner.
El carrito lleva Bs. {value} · suelta lo: The cart holds Bs. {value} · drop what you're carrying to push it
El carrito vacío viene bajando…: The empty cart is coming down…
Bat screeches draw it. When it sniffs at a nook you hear the stone: get out in time.
El farol congela a las momias que alumbr: The lantern freezes the mummies it lights up. In the dark they run faster.
El jaguar negro bajó por el pozo del mon: The black jaguar came down the lift shaft…
El jaguar negro huyó a la oscuridad… por: The black jaguar fled into the dark… for now.
El jaguar negro subió por el pozo del mo: The black jaguar climbed up the lift shaft…
El montacargas baja a la jornada…: The lift is going down to the shift…

El montacargas está ocupado · va subiend: The lift is busy · going up
El montacargas sube al campamento…: The lift is going up to the camp…

El montacargas va al campamento…: The lift is heading to the camp…
El montacargas viene en camino…: The lift is on its way…
El que se quede abajo cuando el montacar: Anyone left below when the lift goes up gets back to camp hanging by a thread.
El que tocó lo que no era: The one who touched the wrong thing
Empuja el carrito a la plataforma de car: Push the cart onto the cargo platform
En la biblioteca anda El Lector, un bibl: El Lector, a blind librarian, haunts the library and hunts by ear: running, jumping, searching, opening chests and fighting make noise; walking or standing still does not. Before it comes it stops dead and cocks its head.
Job lost: a pana went down.
Encargo: junten la cuota antes de que se: Job: meet the quota before the shift ends.
Job: send up the sealed crate.
Job: ride up together in the cage.
Espera a reconectar o abre una expedició: Wait to reconnect or start a local expedition.
Expedición en primera persona por la min: A first-person expedition through the mine and the ruins
Expedición local · el botín cuenta cuand: Local expedition · loot counts once it reaches the truck
Hay cinco lugares: biblioteca, mina, tún: There are five places: library, mine, flooded tunnels, mushroom grotto and fallen temple. Mixed walks through them all in a different order each expedition; in the room, Place picks one.
Jornada 1 · {place}: bajen, llenen el ca: Shift 1 · {place}: go down, fill the cart and send it up the cargo lift until you reach Bs. {quota}.
La bengala se lanza (clic): donde arde,: Throw a flare (click): where it burns, mummies and bats stay back, even in a blackout.
La bóveda de oro. Algo grande respira en: The golden vault. Something big is breathing in the dark…
La codicia: sube con cada tesoro que lev: Greed: it rises with every treasure you lift
La cuerda se amarra en las estacas (E):: Tie a rope to the stakes (E): it opens a way down or a bridge for everyone. Down there, throw the loot (G) up to your panas.
La Estatua solo se mueve cuando nadie la: La Estatua only moves while nobody is looking at it. While any pana has it in view it stays still, and hits barely stagger it: keep your eyes on it or get away from it.
La expedición se guarda en el campamento: The expedition saves at the camp, in the host's browser. To carry on another day: Continue in the room. Join with the same name and you land in your spot.
The ruin groans: dust falls from the ceiling.
Lanza un libro viejo (G) lejos de ti y E: Throw an old book (G) away from you and El Lector will go after the noise. The farol does nothing to it, but a hit staggers it.
Las grietas en el suelo avisan que el te: Cracks on the floor mean a loose ceiling, and swollen mushrooms flip your controls: give them room.
The bandages are moving. Get ready.
Los tesoros grandes piden dos, tres o cu: Big treasures need two, three or four panas: each grabs a side (E) and you walk together. Alone you can only drag them slowly.
Manos llenas · échalo al carrito: Hands full · put it in the cart

Por confiados. La ruina se quedó con tod: Too cocky. The ruin kept it all.
Por el tablón estrecho solo pasan los pa: Only panas fit on the narrow plank: the mummies just stand and stare.
Too clumsy. The ruin kept it all.
Bunch of fools. The ruin kept it all.
Récord: las jornadas que terminas de pie: Record: the shifts you finish standing in one expedition. Comeback: fall, get back up and finish that shift standing.
Rueda activa · ¡la otra!: Wheel active · now the other one!
Rueda activa por doce segundos. ¡La otra: Wheel active for twelve seconds. Now the other one!
Sala llena. Abre otra expedición desde P: Room full. Start another expedition from Pana.
Saquen tesoros de la mina en equipo y su: Haul treasure out of the mine as a team and ride the lift up before greed buries you.
The shift is over. No job this time.
Se puede solo, pero los tesoros grandes: You can play alone, but big treasures need friends. Invite them with the room link.
Si caen todos, del camión solo se salva: If everyone falls, only part of the truck is saved.
Si oyes un siseo, salen culebras de las: A hiss means snakes are coming out of the cracks: they bite and slow you. A machete scatters them and a farol drives them off. They do not fit in the nooks.
Si ves una losa de oro, busca la otra: c: If you see a golden plate, find the other: with weight on both (a pana or the cart) the golden chamber opens.
Sin conexión. Puedes abrir una expedició: No connection. You can start a local expedition.
Solo puedes llevar un arma a la vez: al: You can only carry one weapon at a time: grab another and you drop the one you had.
